Combine:
\[
s^2 = 9t^2 + t \quad \text{and} \quad s^2 \ge 4t.
\]
Thus
\[
9t^2 + t \ge 4t \implies 9t^2 - 3t \ge 0 \implies t(3t-1)\ge 0.
\]
Since \(t=ab>0\), we get
\[
t \ge \frac13.
\]
Equality occurs when \(x=y\), i.e. \(a=b\). Therefore
\[
c = 3t \ge 3\cdot \frac13 = 1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
